== Build notes ==
The clause <code>or 'swing' more than once per battle</code> is Players Committee errata (PC-E1). It is in the PC website Virtual Block 6 card list tooltip for this card on the Wayback capture of 21 July 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html VBlock6Type.html]). The Virtual Block 6.1 sheet (official text 4 September 2009) and the 2013 Virtual Cards Master List omit it. Bill ruled 8 November 2026 that such Master List copies are stale reprints, so PC-E1 is current Legacy text ([[He's No Jedi (Errata)]], GEMP <code>1261_35</code>). The 2009 sheet is the original (this page; GEMP <code>2261_35</code>, Anything Goes). The PC card JSON already has the clause in its first dump (Tom Marlin, 22 June 2020, commit <code>2a8437f</code>); no later JSON commit adds it.
